page.title: Org
page.empty_description: A structure decides who works on what: it routes issues to units, escalates, approves and spends. Pick one of the seven models to start.

new.title: New structure
new.description: Choose where it applies, then the model it follows. You can edit the definition afterwards.
new.workspace_default: Workspace default (every project without its own)
new.replaces_existing: Picking a template replaces the current structure “{{name}}” as a new revision.

purpose.question: What is this team here to do?
purpose.help: One sentence. Its words name the structure and become what each unit picks up.
purpose.label: In one sentence
purpose.placeholder: Answer our customers' tickets within the day.

flow.question: How does the work move?
flow.decider: When a request arrives, who decides in the end?
flow.decider_each_team: Each team, for its own area
flow.shape: Teams by project, by role, or both?

model_line.hierarchy: A clear chain: every team knows who to escalate to.
model_line.squads: Each squad owns its area, its budget and its answer.
model_line.matrix: Competence pools lend their people to the projects that need them.
model_line.circles: Roles, not titles: each circle holds its own decisions.
model_line.owner_network: Flat: one owner and one backup per topic.
model_line.taskforce: A borrowed team with a stated end.
model_line.market: Agents bid; the best offer under your price cap wins.

people.question: Who is part of it?
people.help: Everyone in this workspace, humans and agents.
people.empty: No member or agent in this workspace yet.

review.question: Your draft
review.name: Name
review.draft_note: Nothing is activated: the draft opens in the chart so you can adjust it.
review.replaces_existing: Opening the draft revises the current structure “{{name}}”.

activate.title: Activate the structure
activate.description: Activation needs a human owner and your attestation that the 30-case evaluation set passed. The numbers below come from the preflight.

pause.title: Pause the structure
pause.description: Routing stops until you resume. Issues already assigned keep their assignee.

dissolve.title: Dissolve the structure
dissolve.description: A dissolved structure stops acting and becomes read-only. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete the structure
delete.description: Only drafts and dissolved structures can be deleted. Its revisions go with it.

project_section.none: No structure applies to this project.

issue_section.escalate_description: The structure sends it up the escalation edge. Say why.

canvas.hint: Drag a member onto another unit, or a unit onto the one it reports to.
canvas.empty: No unit yet. Add one to start.
canvas.layout_soon: A layout of its own for {{model}} is coming; the diagram stands in meanwhile.
canvas.no_selection: Pick a unit to open its record.
canvas.json_broken: The JSON below no longer parses; fix it to get the canvas back.

tester.title: Test a request
tester.placeholder: Write it the way a customer or a colleague would.
tester.example_1: My card was declined at checkout, three customers today already.
tester.example_2: Rotate the production database password before Friday.
tester.picker_description: Its title, description and labels fill the request.
tester.empty: Nothing tested yet. Write a request and run it against the chart above.
tester.blocked_consequence: the request will be escalated with its context; this unit will not carry it out.
tester.error_invalid: The definition on the canvas is not valid, so nothing was tested: {{error}}. Settle the problems listed beside the chart first.

problem.unit_name_required: Every unit needs an id and a name.
problem.duplicate_unit_id: The id “{{id}}” is used by two units.
problem.taskforce_unit_model: “{{unit}}”: a task force is a structure, not a unit.
problem.hierarchy_roots: A hierarchy has exactly one unit reporting to nobody; there are {{count}}.
problem.autonomy_over_trust: “{{unit}}” grants {{autonomy}} but {{agent}}'s trust dial stops at {{trust}}.
problem.rule_of_two_unit: “{{unit}}” holds untrusted input, sensitive data and external effects at once: a human approval will be required.
problem.rule_of_two_edge: {{from}} → {{to}} cumulates the three exposures: a human approval will be required on that link.
problem.deciders_missing: “{{unit}}” has external effects: name who decides on {{classes}}.
problem.committee_termination: Committee “{{decision}}”: set a quorum between 1 and {{max}} and at least one round.
problem.market_price_cap: A market needs the human price cap.
problem.squads_needs_agents: “{{unit}}” runs as a squad: give it a squad or agent members.
problem.circles_needs_role: “{{unit}}” runs as circles: give it at least one role.

unit.name: Name
